pairs.why: The two hats are almost identical in their soft satin-matte black, red band and curled brim, and both match the smooth, slightly glossy finish of the real cards equally well.
Both hats are built the same way and rendered the same way; B has a slightly stronger highlight on the crown, but neither looks more like the real cards than the other.
A's brim is slightly fuller and softer, like the plump forms of the real cap and pillow, while B's is a little tighter and darker, though the difference is very small.
They are near-duplicates with the same smooth, untextured finish and soft lighting, so neither matches the real cards better.
B's crown has a slightly brighter specular sheen, which pushes it a touch toward glossy plastic, while A stays closer to the soft satin finish of the real cards.
The shape, color and light are almost the same, and both have the soft rounded finish of the real cards.
B's thicker, rounder brim and compact band look slightly more like a toy, which suits the plump real cap and pillow, though the gap is marginal.
Both hats are built the same, with the same satin-matte finish and red band, and nothing separates them against the real cards.
